sources.title: Lu Tian, STAT331 Unit 5: Cox's Proportional Hazards Model
sources.locator: Unit 7.1–7.4, PDF pp. 1–14; appendix PDF p. 23. The complete 24-page handout was inspected.

contents.name: Unit 7.1–7.2, PDF pp. 1–9: conditional hazard model, fixed-value hazard ratio, risk sets, no-tie partial-likelihood construction, and finite risk-set example
Unit 7.3–7.4, PDF pp. 10–14: conditional/profiling arguments, censored risk-set formula, exact tied-event conventions, Breslow/Efron approximations, score and observed information
Unit 7.3–7.4, PDF pp. 12–14: risk-set partial-likelihood contributions and score/Hessian formulas
Appendix, PDF p. 23: rank-statistic identity under no censoring and no ties
contents.reason: The identity is restricted to uncensored untied data and is not used to justify this page's censored risk-set likelihood or counting-process estimator expansion.

sources.title: Lu Tian, STAT331 Unit 7: Cox's Model: Extensions
sources.locator: Unit 9.3, PDF pp. 8–11, for time-varying covariates; Unit 9.5, PDF p. 16, for the informative-censoring boundary. The complete 20-page handout was inspected.

contents.name: Unit 9.3, PDF pp. 8–11: predictable time-varying covariates and time-dependent treatment hazard ratios
Unit 9.3, PDF pp. 8–11: worked interpretation of time-varying covariates and hazard-ratio checks
Unit 9.5, PDF p. 16: informative censoring and a distinct MAR adjustment model
contents.reason: This pair assumes the stated conditional independent-censoring model and proves no inverse-probability correction or result for informative censoring.

sources.title: Lu Tian, STAT331 Example of Martingale CLT with Cox's Model
sources.locator: PDF pp. 1–7 and 8–11. The complete 12-page handout was inspected; the MCLT proof is referred to elsewhere.

contents.name: PDF pp. 1–2: Cox score written as a sum of predictable integrals against subject martingales
PDF pp. 3–7: bracket and jump calculations for a scalar Cox score and stated martingale-CLT conclusion
PDF pp. 8–11: martingale bracket and functional MCLT statements with the general proof omitted
contents.reason: The page proves a terminal subject-influence expansion and uses the separate IID terminal theorem; it claims no continuous-time functional martingale limit.

sources.title: Lu Tian, STAT331 Revisiting Cox's PH Model: Asymptotic Theory
sources.locator: PDF pp. 1–8, covering score/information limits, consistency assumptions, and estimator linearization. The complete 12-page handout was inspected.

contents.name: PDF pp. 1–5: risk-sum, score-variance, and observed-information formulas for scalar and vector covariates
PDF pp. 6–8: consistency and asymptotic-normality sketches for a consistent Cox score root
PDF pp. 6–8: normal-limit conclusion after Taylor expansion and external martingale CLT

sources.title: Qiqing Yu, Survival Analysis (Lecture Notes), Version 6/8/2010
sources.locator: §5.1, PDF pp. 58–59; §5.2.1–5.2.4, PDF pp. 59–62; §5.3, PDF p. 63. These are the complete relevant Cox/tie sections in the 87-page notes.

contents.name: §5.1, PDF pp. 58–59: proportional hazards versus proportional integrated hazards and the continuity caveat
§5.2.1, PDF pp. 59–60: no-tie risk-set partial likelihood and finite worked risk-set example
§5.2.2, PDF p. 60: exact subset conditional likelihood for grouped/discrete tied failures
§5.2.3–5.2.4, PDF pp. 61–62: conditional probability construction of the continuous no-tie partial likelihood
§5.3, PDF p. 63: interval-censoring likelihood extension
contents.reason: The assigned pair is right-censored Cox regression and does not define an interval-censored likelihood or estimate its nuisance survival law.
